title: Cache (Redis)
description: PENDING — placeholder until Redis cache-aside ships in M5. The backing metrics (cache_hits_total / cache_misses_total) have no call sites yet, so this dashboard is deliberately empty rather than showing panels that would read 'No data' forever.

options.content:
## Pending (M5)

This dashboard is provisioned but intentionally has no query panels yet.

`cache_hits_total` and `cache_misses_total` are specified in the [observability guide](../observability/observability-guide.md) and reserved in [ADR-0009](../architecture/adr/0009-observability-stack.md), but the application does not emit them: there are no call sites until the cache-aside read path lands in **M5** ([ADR-0004](../architecture/adr/0004-redis-cache-aside.md)).

A panel querying a metric nobody exports renders `No data` indefinitely and is indistinguishable from an outage, so the panels are added together with the instrumentation.

**Planned panels**

| Panel | Query | Target |
|---|---|---|
| Hit ratio | `rate(cache_hits_total[5m]) / (rate(cache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(cache_misses_total[5m]))` | >= 90% |
| Hits vs. misses by entity | `sum by (entity) (rate(cache_hits_total[5m]))` | — |
| Redis command latency | redis client spans / instrumentation | — |
| Fallback-to-DB rate | miss rate during a Redis outage | graceful degradation |
